description: This file defines an interface 'ModelWidgetVisitor' for the visitor pattern to traverse and operate on various widget and model classes in the OFBiz framework's widget model package.

classes.name: ModelWidgetVisitor
classes.description: An interface defining visit methods for different widget and model classes, enabling the visitor pattern implementation.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: A set of overloaded methods for visiting specific widget or model instances, each capable of throwing an Exception.
